name: Select
description: Radix Select with a popover-styled content surface, scroll buttons, and typeahead. Renders in a portal.
intent: One choice from a list too long to show all at once.

props.name: position
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: asChild
props.hint: Renders the child element instead of the default one, merging props and styles. Use for links that must look like this component.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Type a letter — jump to matching item
Escape — close and return focus to trigger
requiredAttributes: A label on the trigger, via ui:label htmlFor or aria-label
notes: Radix supplies combobox semantics, focus return and typeahead.
Content is portalled to the body — inside an overflow-hidden container it still renders correctly.
SelectItem with value="" throws. Use a sentinel value for "none".

usage: A known, finite set the user picks from
Grouped options, via SelectGroup and SelectLabel
doNotUse: Under five options where seeing them aids choice — use ui:radio-group
Over about fifty, or anything needing search — use ui:command
Multiple selection — Radix Select is single-select; compose ui:popover with ui:checkbox instead
Actions rather than values — use ui:dropdown-menu

agentRules: Never use an empty string as an item value.
Over fifty options, or any need to search, means ui:command.
Actions belong in ui:dropdown-menu, not here.

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
